title: Pick the Right Rook
setup: Both of your rooks can check on the eighth rank, and Black's bishop on b7 is watching one of them.
hint: Two checks are on offer and only one of them is mate. Look at what the bishop on b7 defends.
explanation:
## The Idea

Ra8+ simply loses a rook to the bishop on b7. {{Re8#}} is mate: nothing defends e8, nothing can block, and the pawns on f7, g7 and h7 hold the king in. On the back rank, always ask which squares the defender still covers.
